4_tool_loop.verdict: NO multi-turn model->tool->observation->model loop exists anywhere in the desktop app or packages. Every model invocation is exactly ONE completion request with ONE user message and no tools parameter; 'toolCalls' in the assistant are locally-authored trace records of deterministic operations.

facts.fact: AiEngine.run renders a prompt, resolves one client, and issues ONE client.complete() with messages=[{role:'user'}]; result is parsed and returned; no loop, no tools
ModelRequest has only model/system/messages/maxOutputTokens - no tools field; Claude request body sends only model/max_tokens/system/messages
assistantService.ask makes at most two runAi calls per turn: reason() or reasonOverReport() (one narrative), plus draft() for content-creation intent; each is a single completion

Assistant 'toolCalls' are AssistantToolCall records pushed by the service for deterministic local operations - retrieval (Context Builder), draft, and productivity resolvers (intelligence/knowledge/automation/operations/strategy/federation) - via this.toolCall(); none is model-initiated and none feeds a subsequent model turn

facts.fact: Turn pipeline order is fixed: mail-intent/clarification -> deterministic answers -> context -> planning -> productivity flows -> reasoning -> drafting -> envelope; the model runs after all local operations, never before them
Deterministic answers (arithmetic, date/time, outstanding invoices, lot/inventory quantity, pending approvals) are resolved BEFORE any model call and short-circuit the turn with processing='none'

Plans are built from deterministic templates: buildPlan(intent.intent, mode, correlationId, targets, now) where targets come from locateTargets over live records; AI output is never an input to buildPlan

The only fields read from model output are answer/executiveSummary, recommendations, assumptions (assistant), text (draft), recommendedAction (engineering), recommendations (founder), plus confidence/evidence by the parser
